colors.name: Ink

colors.name: Charcoal

colors.role: Dark surface tint for elevated dark components and modal/overlay backgrounds; Dark surface fill for elevated panels, toggle/loader component backgrounds

colors.name: Border Soft

colors.name: Border Subtle

fonts.name: Soehne Mono
fonts.role: The exclusive typeface - used for every heading, body, badge, link, icon, and label. Weight 400 dominates; weight 500 is reserved for the 26px hero label. All non-body sizes render in uppercase with tracking between 0.02em and 0.18em. The monospaced face reinforces the museum-catalog, specimen-tag atmosphere.

components.name: Mockup Tile Card
components.role: Primary unit - displays a 3D mockup asset with catalog-style metadata strip

components.name: Framer Component Tile Card
components.role: Second tile variant for interactive component previews

components.name: Section Heading
components.role: Section label above each grid block

components.name: Primary Button
components.role: Filled dark button for 'Buy' and conversion actions

components.name: Ghost Button
components.role: Secondary outlined button paired with primary

do: Use only Soehne Mono (or JetBrains Mono substitute) for every piece of text - no second typeface.
Set every label, badge, and metadata strip in uppercase with tracking between 0.02em and 0.18em.
Render all buttons at 9999px radius and all cards/tiles at 8px radius - the contrast is the system.
Use 1px solid borders in #e0e0e0 for default state, #999999 for hover, and #101010 for strong emphasis.
Keep all mockup assets on pure white backgrounds centered within their tiles - the object IS the content.
Maintain the catalog metadata pattern: asset ID left ('M 005'), asset name right ('IPHONE'), separated by a horizontal divider.
Use #101010 as the sole fill for dark elements - buttons, strokes, silhouettes, checkmark icons, loader arcs.
doNot: Never introduce chromatic color - no blues, greens, reds, or any hue. The system is monochrome.
Never apply box-shadow, drop-shadow, or any elevation effect. Depth comes from hairline borders only.
Never use a sans-serif or proportional typeface. Mono is non-negotiable.
Never use background gradients except for the single conic-gradient loader pattern (#101010 #c8c8c8).
Never set border-radius below 4px on cards or above 9999px on buttons - the radius vocabulary is fixed.
Never use bold (600+) or light (300-) weights. Stay at 400, with 500 reserved for the 26px section heading.
Never mix section heading style - always 26px uppercase #999999 with 0.18em tracking, nothing decorative.
